Assigning Anchors by IoU.zh: 依据 IoU 分配锚框

How does a detector answer &ldquo;where.zh:
检测器如何回答「物体在哪里？」它并不直接回答。它
      预先放置数千个候选框—即 @@T0@@锚框@@T1@@ —并把每一个
      变成一个是/否问题：@@T2@@这里是否有一个物体？@@T3@@ 该分类器的标签来自
      一个数值，即每个锚框与真值之间的交并比。拖动
      下方的物体，观察各锚框如何分边站队。
How does a detector answer &ldquo;where.src: How does a detector answer “where is the object?” It doesn't, directly. It pre-places thousands of candidate boxes — anchors — and turns each one into a yes/no question: does an object sit here? The labels for that classifier come from one number, the Intersection-over-Union between each anchor and the ground truth. Drag the object below and watch the anchors take sides.

@@T0@@~7 min@@T1@@\n @@T2@@Deep Lea.zh:
@@T0@@约 7 分钟@@T1@@
      @@T2@@深度学习 · 目标检测 · 锚框@@T3@@

Regressing a box out of thin air is hard.zh:
凭空回归出一个框是困难的。基于锚框的检测器绕开了这一点：它们用一组
      固定尺寸与宽高比的参考框平铺
      图像，然后向每个锚框提出一个容易得多的问题—是否有物体与我重叠，是还是否？重叠程度
      由交并比来度量：
Regressing a box out of thin air is hard.src:
Regressing a box out of thin air is hard. Anchor-based detectors sidestep it: they tile the
      image with a fixed set of reference boxes at several scales and aspect ratios, then ask each
      anchor a much easier question — is there an object overlapping me, yes or no? The overlap
      is measured by Intersection over Union:

Two thresholds turn that continuous over.zh:
两个阈值把这一连续的叠合度转化为训练标签。若锚框的 IoU 至少为
      $\tau_{\text{pos}}$，则它是@@T0@@正样本@@T1@@（物体）；若其 IoU 低于
      $\tau_{\text{neg}}$，则为@@T2@@负样本@@T3@@（背景）；介于两者之间者被
      @@T4@@忽略@@T5@@，以免含糊的框发出令人困惑的梯度。
Two thresholds turn that continuous over.src: Two thresholds turn that continuous overlap into training labels. An anchor is a positive (object) if its IoU is at least $\tau_{\text{pos}}$, a negative (background) if its IoU is below $\tau_{\text{neg}}$, and is ignored in between so ambiguous boxes don't send confusing gradients.

Drag the object, label the anchors.zh: 拖动物体，为锚框打标签
Drag the object, label the anchors.src: Drag the object, label the anchors

The @@T0@@blue@@T1@@ box is the ground-t.zh:
@@T0@@蓝色@@T1@@框是作为真值的
      物体—用鼠标或滑块拖动它。每一个细框都是一个锚框；每个网格
      位置带有六个—即两个尺度下的三个宽高比。每个锚框按其与物体的 IoU
      被染成@@T2@@正样本@@T3@@、
      @@T4@@忽略@@T5@@或
      @@T6@@负样本@@T7@@，
      而匹配最佳的锚框以粗线绘制。
The @@T0@@blue@@T1@@ box is the ground-t.src: The blue box is the ground-truth object — drag it with the mouse or the sliders. Every thin box is an anchor; each grid location carries six — three aspect ratios at two scales. Each anchor is colored positive, ignore, or negative by its IoU with the object, and the best-matching anchor is drawn bold.

Anchors classified by IoU with the objec.zh: 依与物体的 IoU 分类后的锚框。拖动蓝色框以移动真值。
Anchors classified by IoU with the objec.src: Anchors classified by IoU with the object. Drag the blue box to move the ground truth.

@@T0@@Shrink the object small and drag i.zh:
@@T0@@把物体缩小，并把它拖到网格点之间。@@T1@@ 它与每一个
      锚框的 IoU 都可能低于 $\tau_{\text{pos}}$ —仅凭阈值会得到零个正样本。这正
      是为何 IoU 最高的锚框@@T2@@总是@@T3@@被强制判为正样本（以粗线绘制）：没有这条规则，
      微小或形状古怪的物体将没有锚框可供学习，从而被直接漏掉。
@@T0@@Shrink the object small and drag i.src: Shrink the object small and drag it between grid points. Its IoU with every anchor can drop below $\tau_{\text{pos}}$ — zero positives by the threshold alone. That is why the highest-IoU anchor is always forced positive (drawn bold): without that rule, tiny or oddly-sized objects would have no anchor to learn from and would simply be missed.

Detection is classification plus a nudge.zh: 检测即分类加上一次微调
Detection is classification plus a nudge.src: Detection is classification plus a nudge

Once anchors are labeled, the detector's.zh: 一旦锚框被打了标签，检测器的任务便分成两个熟悉的部件，一同训练：
Once anchors are labeled, the detector's.src: Once anchors are labeled, the detector's job splits into two familiar pieces, trained together:

@@T0@@Classification.@@T1@@ For every an.zh: @@T0@@分类。@@T1@@ 对每个锚框，预测物体与背景。正样本与负样本提供标签；被忽略的锚框不贡献损失。这就是你在别处使用的同一个交叉熵。
@@T0@@Classification.@@T1@@ For every an.src: Classification. For every anchor, predict object vs. background. Positives and negatives supply the labels; ignored anchors contribute no loss. This is the same cross-entropy you use anywhere else.

@@T0@@Box regression.@@T1@@ For positive.zh: @@T0@@框回归。@@T1@@ 仅对正样本锚框，预测一个小偏移 $(\Delta x, \Delta y, \Delta w, \Delta h)$，把锚框平移并拉伸到真值之上—使用上一篇讲解中的 smooth-L1 损失进行训练。
@@T0@@Box regression.@@T1@@ For positive.src: Box regression. For positive anchors only, predict a small offset $(\Delta x, \Delta y, \Delta w, \Delta h)$ that slides and stretches the anchor onto the ground truth — trained with the smooth-L1 loss from the previous explainer.

Because anchors are dense and come in se.zh:
由于锚框密集且形状多样，几乎总会有某个锚框
      与任何物体的距离足够近，可以作为一个起点。「物体在哪里？」于是变成
      「哪些锚框说『是』，以及每个锚框应如何微调它的框？」

@@T0@@Thresholds are a design knob.@@T1@.zh:
@@T0@@阈值是一个设计旋钮。@@T1@@ Faster R-CNN 的 RPN 使用 $\tau_{\text{pos}}=0.7$
      与 $\tau_{\text{neg}}=0.3$；其第二阶段使用 $0.5$。提高 $\tau_{\text{pos}}$，你便只保留
      紧凑的匹配（更干净的正样本，但数量更少）；加宽忽略带，你便丢弃
      更多含糊的锚框。每一个基于锚框的检测器都在调节的，恰恰就是这些数值。
@@T0@@Thresholds are a design knob.@@T1@.src: Thresholds are a design knob. Faster R-CNN's RPN uses $\tau_{\text{pos}}=0.7$ and $\tau_{\text{neg}}=0.3$; its second stage uses $0.5$. Raise $\tau_{\text{pos}}$ and you keep only tight matches (cleaner positives, but fewer of them); widen the ignore band and you throw away more ambiguous anchors. Every anchor-based detector is tuning exactly these numbers.

meta.title: 依据 IoU 分配锚框
meta.tagline: 检测是伪装起来的分类：每个预置的锚框都在问「物体在这里吗？」，而 IoU 阈值提供标签。
meta.summary: 基于锚框的检测器用固定网格的框、以多种尺度与宽高比平铺图像，然后把每个框当作一个是/否分类器来训练。把一个真值框拖过整个网格，观察每个锚框依据其与物体的 IoU 变为正样本、忽略或负样本。移动两个阈值，计数随之改变；匹配最佳的单个锚框始终被保留。这就是「物体在哪里」如何变成一个逐锚框的分类问题。
highlights: 把一个真值框拖过固定的锚框阵列，实时看到每一个被分类为正样本、忽略或负样本。
每个位置上的锚框有多种宽高比，因此宽物体匹配宽锚框，高物体匹配高锚框。
移动上、下两个 IoU 阈值，观察正样本、忽略与负样本的计数即刻重新平衡。
IoU 最高的单个锚框始终被保留为正样本，这与保证每个物体都有匹配的 RPN 规则一致。
看清为何检测实际上是逐锚框的分类加上框回归，而非神秘的「它在哪里」神谕。
